menu:17015030:1.text: Up bright and early to greet the moon.

say:1:1831006001:1.text: What am I doing? Ha! See this headstone beside me?
say:1:1831006001:1.source_cn: 做什么？哈哈……看到我身边这个墓碑没有？
say:1:1831006001:1.male: What am I doing? Ha! See this headstone beside me?
say:1:1831006001:1.female: What am I doing? Ha! See this headstone beside me?

say:2:1831006002:1.text: "Skyden Cranlaw." That's my headstone—and my home. I just woke up and stepped outside.
say:2:1831006002:1.source_cn: 斯凯芬顿·克兰劳，这是我的墓碑，我的家。我刚睡醒出来。
say:2:1831006002:1.male: "Skyden Cranlaw." That's my headstone—and my home. I just woke up and stepped outside.
say:2:1831006002:1.female: "Skyden Cranlaw." That's my headstone—and my home. I just woke up and stepped outside.

say:3:1831006003:1.text: The real question is, why are you lurking outside my front door?
say:3:1831006003:1.source_cn: 倒是你，在我家门口鬼鬼祟祟地干什么呢？
say:3:1831006003:1.male: The real question is, why are you lurking outside my front door?
say:3:1831006003:1.female: The real question is, why are you lurking outside my front door?
